issue: DSG dual-clutch gearbox mechatronic unit wear
content: Jerky low-speed engagement, hesitation from a stop, or a mechatronic fault code on the 7-speed DSG. Root cause is clutch pack wear or mechatronic unit electronics degrading with age and high stop-start use, typically from 100,000 km. Left unaddressed it can strand the car in limp mode.
